ModMetaData.name: Custom Pawn Generation
ModMetaData.author: Nyan
ModMetaData.description:
Allows you to change how pawns are generated.
[b]Gender[/b] [list] [*] [b]Separate Gender Stats[/b]: Allows you to have 2 separate configurations for males and females. [*] [b]Override Forced Gender[/b]: Ignores backstory-forced and parent-forced gender. May cause minor bugs, such as single parents. [*] [b]Override Gender Frequency[/b]: Changes which gender is more common, or have the entire game with only 1 gender. [/list]
[b]Age[/b] [list] [*] [b]Preserve Age Curve[/b]: If there is a minimum or maximum age set, this will attempt to mimic the vanilla age distribution, such that it won't be dominated by extremely young/old pawns. [*] [b]Add Excess Biological Age as Chronological Age[/b]: When maximum age is set and a pawn exceeds the limit, it increases the chronological age instead. This will still trigger a birthday event. [*] [b]Has Maximum Age[/b]: Adds a maximum age limit. This can still trigger a birthday event. [*] [b]Has Minimum Age[/b]: When a pawn is generated, their age will not be lower than this number. [*] [b]Do Not Affect Pawns Below Minimum Age[/b]: If the pawn is supposed to spawn below the minimum age (toddler,) they will not be affected by the minimum age limit. [*] [b]Override Age Tick[/b]: Allows increasing aging speed. Setting to 0 will completely disable aging. [/list]
[b]Body Type[/b] [list] [*] [b]Filter Body Types[/b]: Allows preventing body types from being chosen. A random allowed body type will be chosen when a pawn is generated with an undesired body type. Must have at least 1 body type allowed, otherwise nothing happens. [/list]
[b]Traits[/b] [list] [*] [b]Forced[/b]: Allows a trait to be forced to every single pawn generated. [*] [b]Blocked[/b]: Prevents this trait from appearing on any pawn. [/list]
[b]Advanced Settings[/b] [list] [*] Allows you to set a separate configuration for each race. [*] Unchecking the `Advanced Settings` checkbox does not disable this, it only makes the UI less complicated. [*] When unchecked, all changes go to the `[Global Config]` configuration. [/list]
